note: Provider-neutral. The video pipeline never reads this file; it exists so a voice can be re-sourced from any provider, or recorded by a human, without the animation changing. Only scripts/voice/* reads it.

pronunciation.note: Medical terminology stays English inside the Arabic sentence and must not be Arabized, inflected or translated. Adapters apply these as provider-specific hints; none of them may alter the written line.

Rashid.role: Saudi host — explains, corrects, never condescends

voice.generationInstructions: Saudi Arabic, educated and unhurried. Warm teaching register, never lecturing or theatrical. Let clauses land; do not rush the retrieval pauses. Keep English medical terms in clear English pronunciation inside the Arabic sentence.

voiceAlternates.generationInstructions: Speak Saudi Arabic as an educated, unhurried male host in his thirties. Warm teaching register, never theatrical. Pronounce English medical terms in clear English.
Male, Saudi dialect, 25-40. Calm, warm, unhurried. Record one line per file, quiet room, no processing, no music. Leave the scripted pause silent rather than filling it.

Salem.role: Saudi friend — confident, wrong, funny, never stupid

voice.generationInstructions: Saudi Arabic, younger and brighter than Rashid. Casual, quick, confident even when wrong. Comic timing comes from certainty, never from mugging. One line is sung briefly and badly on purpose — keep it human and short, not a performance.

voiceAlternates.generationInstructions: Speak Saudi Arabic as a younger male friend, casual and quick, confident even when wrong. Light comic timing from certainty, not from exaggeration.
Male, Saudi dialect, 20-30. Brighter and quicker than Rashid. Confident even when wrong. Record one line per file, quiet room, no processing.

Noura.role: Saudi colleague — dry, precise, lands the correction in one line

voice.generationInstructions: Saudi Arabic, female, dry and composed. She does not raise her voice to be funny; the line is funny because it is flat and correct. Short, unimpressed, never sarcastic-cruel.
